<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->

    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="14" x2="335" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="337" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="361" y="11" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="13" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="382" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="54" width="78" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <rect x="112" y="54" width="78" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <rect x="196" y="54" width="78" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="280" y="54" width="82" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Back arrow -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="39,91 29,101 39,111" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="101" x2="55" y2="101" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="28" y="158" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Who do you want to see?</text>
  <text x="28" y="188" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose one or more options</text>

  <!-- Option cards -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="220" width="342" height="108" rx="18" fill="#FEF3F6"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="24" y="218" width="342" height="108" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="272" r="30" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="262" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="270" x2="72" y2="292" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>

  <circle cx="338" cy="272" r="12" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <polyline points="332,272 337,277 345,267" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <rect x="24" y="344" width="342" height="108" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="72" y1="396" x2="72" y2="418" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="406" x2="84" y2="406" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="418" x2="60" y2="429" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="79" y1="418" x2="84" y2="429" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="121" y="415" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Show me men</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="398" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <rect x="24" y="470" width="342" height="108" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="524" r="30" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="514" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="522" x2="72" y2="544" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="532" x2="84" y2="532" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="544" x2="60" y2="555" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="121" y="541" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Explore all genders</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="524" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Helper and continue -->
  <text x="195" y="612" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can change this anytime in Settings</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="65" y="646" width="260" height="48" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="65" y="642" width="260" height="48" rx="24" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="672" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <line x1="0" y1="736" x2="390" y2="736" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>

    <text x="209" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="285" y="755" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="290,771 287,777 297,771" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="291" cy="763" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="296" cy="763" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="301" cy="763" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="296" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">CHAT</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="143" y="826" width="104" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
